outcomeNote: anonymous mishna ruling with no dispute

segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הַנּוֹתֵן מִזַּרְעוֹ לַמּוֹלֶךְ, אֵינוֹ חַיָּיב עַד שֶׁיִּמְסוֹר לַמּוֹלֶךְ וְיַעֲבִיר בָּאֵשׁ. מָסַר לַמּוֹלֶךְ וְלֹא הֶעֱבִיר בָּאֵשׁ, הֶעֱבִיר בָּאֵשׁ וְלֹא מָסַר לַמּוֹלֶךְ – אֵינוֹ חַיָּיב עַד שֶׁיִּמְסוֹר לַמּוֹלֶךְ וְיַעֲבִיר בָּאֵשׁ.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «One who gives of his offspring to Molekh,» for which one is executed by stoning, «is not liable unless he hands over» his child «to the» priests of «Molekh and passes» the child «through the fire.» If «he handed over» the child «to the» priests of «Molekh but did not pass» him «through the fire,» or if «he passed» him «through the fire but did not hand» him «over to the» priests of «Molekh, he is not liable, unless he hands» the child «over to the» priests of «Molekh and passes» him «through the fire.»

positions.claim: one is liable only if he both hands the child to Molekh and passes him through the fire
